bytes: wire bytes: every request sends Accept-Encoding and Caddy compresses (`encode gzip zstd`), so these are what crosses the network, not the rendered size

vantages.edge: from a developer laptop over the internet: TLS, HTTP/2, Caddy, Astro, FastAPI, Postgres
vantages.caddy: on the box, over loopback to the same virtual host: everything but the internet
vantages.astro: on the box, to the Astro container's port 4321: no Caddy, no TLS
vantages.api: on the box, to the FastAPI container's port 8001: no Caddy, no Astro
